 ## 5 · How to run it again
 
+Operator setup requires an authorized target with the account schema already applied.
+`scripts/operator-seed.mjs` requires explicit `--local` or `--remote`, `--env default` or a configured
+named environment, `--db` with its configured binding/name, `--database-id` with the expected UUID,
+an ASCII `--email`, and `--password-stdin`. Remote setup also requires the authorized `--account-id`.
+Supply an already-held temporary password through a protected non-TTY stdin source; it is never
+printed or accepted as an argument. Existing accounts are preserved on rerun, including their
+passwords and privileges. Secure handoff and actual account/resource authorization remain prerequisites.
+
 ```
-node scripts/operator-seed.mjs --email <you>@<brand> --admin --env staging      # once; the password is shown once
 node scripts/load-test.mjs --base https://<stamp> --sdk-key <site key> --rps 40 --seconds 120 --token <operator jwt>
 ```
 
 The script prints the achieved rate, latency per request kind, errors by status, then after forty-five
